title: AIESEC
description: AIESEC, a youth leadership organization, uses a vivid multi-color palette: blue (#037ef3), coral (#f85a40), teal green (#30c39e), teal (#0a8ea0), orange (#f48924), yellow (#ffc845), charcoal (#52565e), light gray (#caccd1), and near-white (#f3f4f7). These colors come from AIESEC's official brand materials.
